title: backlog.py begin ID... starts the next ready items in one call: overlap check, claim, claim push and detached dispatch
goal: begin ID... --by NAME --dry-run prints one line per item, the claim and dispatch it would make or the refusal, and writes nothing; an item whose touches overlap an earlier item of the batch or a held claim is refused with the overlap named and the others are still planned, with exit 1 when any item was refused

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init","-q");(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","scratch_dir":"_cache/scratch"}));(r/"items").mkdir()
def item(i,**k):
 d=dict(id=i,kind="story",title="t",status="todo",priority="P3",goal="g",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]);d.update(k)
 (r/"items"/(i+".json")).write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+"\n")
def commit():g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i")
env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk");env.pop("KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG",None)
def run(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
(r/"items"/"SP-cccccccc.json").write_text(json.dumps({"id":"SP-cccccccc","kind":"sprint","title":"s","status":"active","goal":"g"}))
item("ST-aaaaaaaa",sprint="SP-cccccccc");item("ST-bbbbbbbb",sprint="SP-cccccccc");item("ST-cccccccc",sprint="SP-cccccccc",touches=["y.txt"]);commit()
p=run("begin","ST-aaaaaaaa","ST-bbbbbbbb","ST-cccccccc","--by","claude-chk","--dry-run")
o=p.stdout+p.stderr;bl=[x for x in o.splitlines() if "ST-bbbbbbbb" in x]
print(p.returncode,o[-400:])
ok=p.returncode==1 and bl and "overlap" in bl[0] and "ST-cccccccc" in o and not g("status","--porcelain")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
